details.description: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's (formerly Zhipu AI) open-weight Mixture-of-Experts flagship model, released June 16, 2026, per Z.ai's release notes. It has 753 billion parameters and a 1,048,576-token (1M) context window, per its Hugging Face model card and configuration, and uses an IndexShare sparse-attention design that Z.ai says reduces per-token compute at long context lengths. It supports thinking modes, function calling, streaming, structured JSON output, and MCP tool integration, and Z.ai positions it for large-scale codebase comprehension, multi-file refactoring, and long-horizon agentic engineering. It is released under the MIT license. Fireworks AI, which hosts this model, states that serverless access to GLM-5.2 ends September 25, 2026, directing users to migrate to GLM-5.3, while on-demand deployment continues indefinitely.
advantages: Scores 62.1 on SWE-bench Pro and 91.2 on GPQA-Diamond, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 99.2 on AIME 2026 and 81.0 on Terminal Bench 2.1 (Terminus-2), per its Hugging Face model card.
1,048,576-token (1M) context window, using an IndexShare architecture Z.ai says reduces per-token compute at long context lengths, per its Hugging Face model card.
Released under the permissive MIT license.
Scores higher than GLM-5.1 on every benchmark Z.ai lists for both models, including SWE-bench Pro (62.1 vs. 58.4) and AIME 2026 (99.2 vs. 95.3), per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Fireworks AI states that serverless access to this model ends September 25, 2026, directing users to migrate to GLM-5.3; on-demand deployment continues indefinitely.
Superseded as Z.ai's flagship by GLM-5.3, released August 18, 2026, per Z.ai's release notes.
use_cases: Large-scale codebase comprehension and multi-file refactoring
Long-horizon agentic engineering and terminal-based operations
Mobile and on-device development and debugging

notes: Fireworks' serverless-deprecation date for GLM-5.2 (September 25, 2026, migrate to GLM-5.3) matches the catalog's deprecation_date exactly; on-demand deployment is unaffected per the same Fireworks page. Catalog's max_input_tokens (1,048,576) and max_output_tokens (131,072) match the Hugging Face config's max_position_embeddings and Fireworks/Z.ai's stated 128K max output exactly.
